request_text: Can you tell me what personal information you hold about me? This is an information request only; I still use the account, so please do not delete anything.
Please remove me from marketing lists only. I still want receipts and service messages for my orders.
My surname is misspelled on the account. Can you correct it without removing any of my records?
I used a different email on this account before changing it. Please remove records under both addresses and switch off any integration that could copy them back into search or analytics.
I deleted this account and received a confirmation, but the same email address is still recognized. Please remove any remaining copy of my profile.

I am asking you to remove my account and the personal information linked to it. Please review any identifiers connected to this account as part of the request. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
Can you verify that my account was deleted? A search result with a similar email belongs to someone else, so please do not treat that record as mine.
이 이메일 주소에 연결된 계정의 영구 삭제를 요청합니다. 개인정보 처리 절차에 따라 현재 및 이전 식별자를 검토해 주세요. 검토가 완료되면 결과를 확인해 주세요.
